dedupe_keys.name: measurement dataset from all traction substations of madrid metro line 10b including a reversible substation

description: The e-TRENY project deposits electrical measurements from the five traction-power substations supplying Madrid Metro Line 10B on 2 and 3 March 2025. Its public README describes a roughly 15 km line with 11 stations, 48 hours of 10 Hz DC recordings and about half an hour of 50 kHz AC recordings on each day. The La Moraleja site has a 2 MW reversible converter in parallel with a 3 MW diode rectifier, allowing braking energy to return to the AC grid. Zenodo lists 59 public MATLAB data files and a short PDF README under CC BY 4.0: ten named substation-day files plus 49 AC segments. These measurements could calibrate a rail traction-energy, regenerative-braking or grid-interaction simulation. The README initially describes ten files but does not enumerate the additional AC segments; the exact time stitching is unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this line. The MATLAB files were not downloaded or analysed.
